meta.name: frame-light-leak-cinema
meta.description: 胶片漏光 + 颗粒噪点 + 16:9 letterbox + 衬线大字, 电影感开场 / 章节卡

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加胶片漏光与电影感字幕
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让视频片段拥有复古胶片电影的开场效果。
copy.tagline_en: Add film light leaks and cinematic subtitles to videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to give your video clips a retro film look with light leaks and letterbox.

howto.what: 把开场或章节标题做成一张电影帧:暖色漏光、颗粒噪点、上下黑边、衬线大字,自动配上年份/章节/地点角标,输出单文件HTML。
howto.when: 当需要电影感开场或章节卡时触发。典型入口:要求做“电影开场”、“章节标题页”、“胶片质感画面”等。

say.text: 做一张暖橙色漏光的电影开场,标题《夜航》
say.note: 生成带漏光和黑边的开场帧HTML

say.text: 为短片生成2.39:1章节卡,副标“第二章”,地点“里斯本”
say.note: 输出含章节、地点角标的窄屏帧

say.text: 用35mm颗粒和衬线字做复古标题页,标题《旧日》
say.note: 得到仿胶片颗粒感的标题页面

howto.what_en: Creates a single-frame cinematic opening or chapter card with warm light-leak glow, film grain, letterbox bars, serif headline, and corner metadata, output as standalone HTML.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a cinematic opening title, chapter card, or film-grain styled frame. Typically after the user provides a title.

say_en.text: Make a warm orange light-leak opening frame with the title 'Night Voyage'.
say_en.note: Produces an opening frame HTML with leak and letterbox.

say_en.text: Create a 2.39:1 chapter card, subtitle 'Chapter 2', location 'Lisbon'.
say_en.note: Outputs a widescreen frame with chapter and location corner text.

say_en.text: Design a retro title page with 35mm grain and serif type, title 'Old Days'.
say_en.note: Gives a film-grain styled title page.
